title: Early Peanut Eating Cut Allergy Risk To 1.9%
hook: Early peanut eating cut allergy risk to 1.9%.
closing: Better evidence reversed old guidance, so parents should discuss early introduction with their doctor.
question: Would you follow the newer advice?

segments.say: Peanut allergy reached 1.4% of US children, even while parents were told to delay exposure.
Early peanut eaters had 1.9% allergy risk, overturning the advice that avoidance was safer.
Diagnoses later fell to 0.45%, an encouraging shift after early-introduction guidance changed.
